notes.title: New Update!!!
notes.content:
New Great news, dear dragon riders!

The game now allows you to use your voice in battle to command your dragon to breathe fire, perform other actions, and even cast magical spells to defeat your opponents!

In addition to this fantastic new feature, a multilingual support has been added for runtime translation of character descriptions and narrative text into 36 different languages! 

And if that wasn't enough...
A generative dialogue system with Text to Speech feature has also been implemented, allowing players to freely converse with certain NPCs outside the battlefield to learn more about the magical world of Entelos.

Recap:

[b]Voice control to cast spells and to control the dragon.
 
Multilingual support. 

Generative Dialogue System with Text To Speech for player and NPCs.[/b]
            
And as the pics suggest, more major updates are coming!!!!
